# Paginated search helper

def search_all_notes(query):
    results = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('query', query, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(resp.get('success', resp if isinstance(resp, list) else [])))
        # API returns success list directly? Let's normalize
        if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'success' in resp:
            page = resp['success']
        elif isinstance(resp, list):
            page = resp
        else:
            page = []
        results.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return results

import re

note_content = note_detail['content']
print(note_content)

shares=[]
for line in note_content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    m=re.match(r'^-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$', line)
    if m:
        name=m.group(1).strip()
        amt=float(m.group(2))
        shares.append((name, amt))
print('parsed shares', shares)
shares_dict={name:amt for name,amt in shares}
print('shares_dict', shares_dict)

# Fetch friend contacts from phone
phone_token = phone_token  # from earlier

rels = apis.phone.show_contact_relationships(access_token=phone_token)
print('available_relationships', rels)
# pick relationship category matching 'friend'
relationship_category=None
for r in rels:
    if r.lower() in ['friend','friends','buddy']:
        relationship_category=r
        break
# if exact not found, try contains 'friend'
if relationship_category is None:
    for r in rels:
        if 'friend' in r.lower():
            relationship_category=r
            break
print('relationship_category', relationship_category)

# search contacts with relationship filter
contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship=relationship_category, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('contacts page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    contacts.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1
print('total friend contacts', len(contacts))
for c in contacts:
    full=(c.get('first_name','')+' '+c.get('last_name','')).strip()
    print('contact', c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), 'email', c.get('email'), 'phone', c.get('phone_number'))

# Build mapping from contact name tokens to emails
name_to_emails={}
for c in contacts:
    first=c.get('first_name','').strip()
    last=c.get('last_name','').strip()
    email=c.get('email')
    if email:
        if first:
            name_to_emails.setdefault(first.lower(), set()).add(email)
        if last:
            name_to_emails.setdefault(last.lower(), set()).add(email)
        if first and last:
            name_to_emails.setdefault((first+' '+last).lower(), set()).add(email)
print('name_to_emails', {k:list(v) for k,v in list(name_to_emails.items())[:10]})

# Map note share names to candidate emails using name matching
note_names=list(shares_dict.keys())
print('note_names', note_names)

share_emails={}
for n in note_names:
    nl=n.lower().strip()
    cand=set()
    # exact first token match
    if nl in name_to_emails:
        cand |= name_to_emails[nl]
    # if name contains space, also try variants
    if ' ' in nl:
        parts=nl.split()
        for p in parts:
            cand |= name_to_emails.get(p, set())
    else:
        # try matching with first names and last names already done
        pass
    share_emails[n]=cand
print('share_emails_candidates', {k:list(v) for k,v in share_emails.items()})

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Dinner window: use phone current date (Saturday, May 20, 2023) and yesterday (Friday, May 19, 2023)
current_dt = datetime.strptime(apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()['date'], '%A, %B %d, %Y')
yesterday_dt = current_dt - timedelta(days=1)
min_created_at = yesterday_dt.date().isoformat()
max_created_at = current_dt.date().isoformat()

print('venmo received window', min_created_at, 'to', max_created_at)

# Candidate payer list: emails from simple note
share_emails_map = {'Adrian': ['adrian_burt@gmail.com'], 'Katie': ['kat_simp@gmail.com'], 'Martin': ['mar_blac@gmail.com'], 'Robin': ['roburton@gmail.com'], 'Matthew': ['matthew.blac@gmail.com'], 'Melissa': ['mel.bailey@gmail.com'], 'Glenn': ['glenn.burton@gmail.com'], 'Brenda': ['brenda.webe@gmail.com']}
all_candidate_emails=set()
for v in share_emails_map.values():
    all_candidate_emails |= set(v)
print('candidate_emails_count', len(all_candidate_emails), all_candidate_emails)

    for line in content.splitlines():

    email=c.get('email')
    if email:
        if first:
            name_to_emails.setdefault(first.lower(), set()).add(email)
        if last:
            name_to_emails.setdefault(last.lower(), set()).add(email)
        if first and last:
            name_to_emails.setdefault((first+' '+last).lower(), set()).add(email)

for name in all_shares.keys():
    nl=name.lower().strip()
    cand=set()
    if nl in name_to_emails:
        cand |= name_to_emails[nl]
    # also attempt partial matches by tokens
    for token in nl.split():
        cand |= name_to_emails.get(token, set())
    # remove empties
    cand = {e for e in cand if e}
    share_emails[name]=sorted(cand)
